description: Tabulate a FreeSurfer subject's subcortical segmentation volumes (stats/aseg.stats) with asegstats2table: one row for the subject, one column per structure, in mm3.

subjects_dir.description: FreeSurfer SUBJECTS_DIR, e.g. the recon-all output.

aseg.description: Tab-separated aseg volumes (mm3), one row per subject.

block.label: aseg stats table (FreeSurfer)
block.description: Subcortical volumes from a recon-all subject.

requirements: FreeSurfer 7 or newer (asegstats2table); FREESURFER_HOME is set from the executable found
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs asegstats2table --sd <subjects_dir> --subjects <subject> --meas volume --delimiter tab --tablefile aseg.tsv through the shared native CLI adapter.

useWhen: Turn a finished recon-all subject's aseg.stats into a table of structure volumes.

avoidWhen.when: You have a label map rather than a recon-all subject.

effects: Writes aseg.tsv to the output directory.

duration.basis: One run on FreeSurfer's bert sample subject on an Apple-silicon Mac: 0.5 s.

failures.meaning: No FreeSurfer install with asegstats2table was found.
failures.remedy: Install FreeSurfer, or set FREESURFER_ASEGSTATS2TABLE to its bin/asegstats2table.

failures.meaning: The subject has no readable stats/aseg.stats.
failures.remedy: Check that recon-all finished for this subject (scripts/recon-all.log ends with 'finished without error').
